scenicChapters.title: Nortorf coffee stop → Rendsburg canal view
scenicChapters.narrative: 62 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it. Speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.

scenicChapters.title: Baltic Coast Scenic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 42 km this is Baltic Coast Scenic Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

scenicChapters.title: Neustadt bay → Back to Plön lake road
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 83 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

kiel-westensee-nortorf-canal-sweep-and-k.story: A 239 km loop that starts and ends near Kiel, about 4 h 20 of riding. It goes by way of Westensee, Nortorf and Neustadt.
